chibi-ore-2.notes: Four faceted copper-orange ore chunks around a small dark blue-grey rock, thick black outline, no plate. Warm orange (hue about 26) against the cool grey of both Mountain variants: unmistakable at 1:1 and zoom 0.75, where the batch-3 grey-and-pale-blue Ore blended into the rock. About 25 x 27 px of the 40 x 40 canvas, clearly smaller than a unit; orange sits between Coral (hue 2, salmon) and Gold (hue 44, mustard) and matches neither, and is far from Teal and Violet.
